source_snapshot.procedure: From BMC run `i2cdetect -y -q 15` and `i2ctransfer -y 15 w3@0x44 0xc0 0x0 0x0 r4`; consult PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Only generic evidence/photo and unexpected-log checks; no shared-controller ownership,0x44 identity,0xc00000 register semantics or expected four bytes.

test_case.test_name: Test connections between HMC I2C-13, BMC I2C-16 and UPHY3 from second PG548 — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify the management connection from BMC I2C-16 and HMC I2C-13 to UPHY3 on the second PG548 by obtaining a valid UPHY3 register response through the authoritative bus path without colliding with the other controller.
required_package: PID1114953 topology mapping BMC I2C-16 and HMC I2C-13 to bus15/second-PG548 UPHY3
Definition whether controllers are multi-master, bridged or muxed and current bus owner
Proof address0x44 identifies the intended UPHY3 instance
UPHY vendor definition for three-byte pointer0xc00000 and four-byte response fields/values
Confirmation pointer write is non-mutating plus endianness/alignment
Arbitration/quiescence, timeout/NACK/error criteria, ownership restoration and independent BMC/HMC recovery
test_case.test_command: Map logical BMC I2C-16 and HMC I2C-13 to Linux bus15 and document bridge/mux/multi-master ownership; identify0x44 as second-PG548 UPHY3; confirm0xc00000 is a safe readable register; quiesce or arbitrate the HMC side; issue one bounded four-byte read; decode expected fields and correlate both controllers' error/status logs; restore any ownership/mux state.
test_case.expected_result: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test."

safety_gate: Do not run broad `i2cdetect -q` on a shared management bus without address-by-address approval
Prove controller ownership and quiesce/coordinate the peer before raw access
Confirm0xc00000 is a read pointer for this UPHY revision and not a command/write window
Perform one bounded transfer; abort on arbitration loss, unexpected owner, NACK, timeout, stuck bus or loss of BMC/HMC/UPHY management
Restore any mux/ownership state and verify both controllers can access their required endpoints
expected_evidence: PID topology for HMC I2C-13/BMC I2C-16/bus15/second-PG548 UPHY3
BMC/HMC/PG548/UPHY hardware/firmware identities and current owner/arbitration state
Vendor definition for0x44 pointer0xc00000 and expected four-byte matrix
Timestamped exact transfer with stdout/stderr, exit code, latency and decoded fields
Pre/post BMC I2C-16, HMC I2C-13 and UPHY3 error/status logs
Ownership restoration plus BMC/HMC endpoint health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Wistron I2C policy requires both management controllers, bus/address, OOB path, vendor spec and expected response. The apparent dual-controller path makes ownership/arbitration mandatory before raw access.

source_conflict.reason: The row names two logical controllers but supplies only a BMC bus15 command without topology/ownership semantics. It omits0x44/register/response definitions and earlier reviews add physical probing absent from the source.
